name: arr-dashboard
description: A unified dashboard for managing multiple Sonarr, Radarr, and Prowlarr instances. Features include unified queue/calendar/history views, global indexer search, library management, TRaSH Guides integration, automated hunting, statistics, and TMDB content discovery.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Optional: PostgreSQL connection string (e.g., postgresql://user:password@host:5432/database). Leave empty to use default SQLite database.

variables.name: BACKUP_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for encrypted backups. Required for backup/restore functionality. Use a strong password (16+ characters) and store it securely.

variables.name: SESSION_TTL_HOURS
variables.description: How long sessions last before requiring re-login (in hours)

variables.name: WEBAUTHN_RP_NAME
variables.description: For passkey authentication: Display name shown to users during passkey registration.

variables.name: WEBAUTHN_RP_ID
variables.description: For passkey authentication: Your domain name without protocol (e.g., arr.example.com). Leave empty for localhost.

variables.name: WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN
variables.description: For passkey authentication: Full URL with protocol (e.g., https://arr.example.com). Leave empty for http://localhost:3000.

variables.name: API_RATE_LIMIT_MAX
variables.description: Maximum API requests per minute. Increase if you have many services or experience rate limiting.

variables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
variables.description: Optional GitHub personal access token. Increases rate limits for TRaSH Guides updates from 60 to 5000 requests/hour.
